season.evidence: Searched: ranger report on July 6 had the Sibley Pass approach still very snowy; Hidden Lake stays frozen until late June or early July; area is also a ski objective in spring. Peakbagger ascents Jun-Oct, Aug highest. Matches stored mid-July to September.

track.why: Sep 1 2022, summited, trailhead round trip from our Hidden Lake pin (33 m): climbs to Sibley Pass, crosses the Triad Glacier side at 1,960-2,000 m past the west and middle summits without visiting them, reaches the east summit (1 m of pin) and returns by the same line. That is the East Peak route as our text describes it, and it is not the three-summit traverse. Logged route name is blank and there is no report text, so identity rests on the line.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 17 2026 "W Face"; same line but starts 1.4 km and 350 m lower on the access road; the logged name does not match ours.
